CC: ankle arthritis flare with new contralateral knee pain

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to multiple painful calluses. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with multiple painful calluses. Separately identified: tenderness at a distinct anatomic location with documented quality, palpable swelling, and pain on resisted motion.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Paring of multiple hyperkeratotic lesions performed. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
